assumptions: 'Been in the inspection zone for one second' interpreted as DWELL continuously inside >=1000 ms with any motion (max_speed null).
'Reach packing within 6 seconds' interpreted as CROSSES packing_entry with 6000 ms limit measured from satisfaction of the 1-second dwell to the crossing.
'Reach packing' direction interpreted as normal left-to-right travel, which per the given mapping is direction to_left.
Objects that never dwell 1 second in inspection vacuously pass.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every blue box that dwells continuously in the inspection zone for at least 1 second must cross the packing_entry line in the to_left direction within 6 seconds afterwards.

assumptions: passing through inspection means being inside the inspection zone for at least 1 consecutive frame
reaching packing means crossing packing_entry in the forward left-to-right travel direction, which is labeled to_left
crossing packing_entry in the opposite direction does not count as reaching packing
no maximum time limit between inspection and packing crossing
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every blue box that crosses packing_entry to the left must have been in the inspection zone before that crossing.

assumptions: Crossing into packing is crossing line 'packing_entry' in direction 'to_left' (rightwards/+x), per the stated left-to-right travel mapping.
'Stay at least 1.5 seconds' is DWELL continuously inside zone 'inspection' for >=1500 ms with any motion allowed (max_speed null), not requiring stopped.
No maximum gap between dwell and crossing is enforced (within_ms null); only ordering before the first crossing is required.
Boxes that never cross packing_entry pass vacuously.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every blue box that crosses packing_entry to_left must have dwelled continuously in the inspection zone for at least 1500 ms before that crossing.

assumptions: Going into packing is interpreted as crossing packing_entry in direction to_left, since boxes travel left-to-right (+x) which maps to to_left.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every blue box that crosses packing_entry to the left must have previously stopped in inspection for at least 1000 ms.
